title: Chinese fugitive wanted for P45.2-M telco fraud nabbed in Parañaque
summary: MANILA, Philippines — A Chinese national wanted in China for allegedly being involved in a telecommunications fraud syndicate was arrested in Parañaque City, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) reported…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Chinese national wanted in China for allegedly being involved in a telecommunications fraud syndicate was arrested in Parañaque City, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) reported on Monday. In a statement, the BI identified the Chinese fugitive as Chen Yongzhou, 39. According to BI Fugitive Search Unit Chief Rendel Ryan Sy, Chen, who was nabbed on Oct. 14, was involved in a syndicate that defrauded victims in China of more than 4.73 million renminbi, or approximately P45.2 million.
